text: Network meta-analysis (NMA) provides a useful framework for addressing this question because it integrates direct and indirect evidence and permits several interventions to be compared within the same analysis, even when head-to-head trials are limited. To our knowledge, no previous study has systematically compared different exercise modalities for women’s body image using this approach. We therefore conducted a systematic review and frequentist network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials to compare aerobic exercise, resistance training, dance, mind–body exercise, and multimodal exercise, while retaining behavioral intervention as a separate active comparator.
source_label: Effects of different exercise types on body image in females: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
